title: Thai Wrap with Kinako Crunch
description: A fusion of Thai and Japanese flavors in a crispy wrap. Crunchy kinako adds texture to this sweet and savory dish.

ingredients.name: Harmonious Hummus
ingredients.notes: Classic hummus recipe with chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon

instructions: 1. Preheat a dry skillet or griddle over medium heat.
2. Brush the wrap with sesame oil and toast until crispy.
3. Spread harmonious hummus on the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
4. Sprinkle German curry powder over the hummus.
5. Top with thinly sliced green onions and chopped cilantro.
6. Sprinkle kinako crumbs over the top.
7. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap tightly.
8. Slice in half and serve immediately.
